2609.15172.title: STHMoE: Hypergraph-Enhanced Heterogeneous Dependency Coordination for LLM-Based Urban Traffic Data Forecasting
2609.15172.paper_summary: Spatio-temporal traffic forecasting is a fundamental big data analytics task for intelligent transportation systems, where massive urban sensor streams exhibit heterogeneous, non-stationary, and structurally dynamic patterns. Although recent deep learning and large language model (LLM)-based methods have advanced traffic forecasting, they often remain temporally centered and lack effective coordination of temporal, spectral, pairwise spatial, and higher-order structural cues under evolving traffic regimes. To address this heterogeneous dependency coordination problem, we propose STHMoE, a Spatio-Temporal Hypergraph-Enhanced Mixture of Experts framework for urban traffic data forecasting. STHMoE decouples traffic dynamics into frequency-domain, time-domain, spatio-domain, and higher-order spatial representations, which are modeled by prompt-guided heterogeneous experts built upon a partially frozen LLM backbone. The first three experts leverage domain-specific statistical prompts, while the higher-order spatio expert uses a structural placeholder prompt and obtains dependency information from an adaptive hypergraph module. To capture evolving spatial structures in traffic data,, STHMoE jointly learns first-order graph dependencies and higher-order group interactions without predefined topologies. An entropy-aware MoE router with coefficient-of-variation load balancing adaptively fuses expert outputs while improving expert utilization and routing confidence. Experiments on 10 real-world traffic benchmarks show that STHMoE achieves competitive performance against temporal, spatio-temporal graph, and LLM-based baselines.
2609.15172.paper_summary_zh: 時空交通預測是智能交通系統中的一項基本大數據分析任務，其中大量城市傳感器流顯示出異質性、非平穩性和結構動態模式。儘管最近基於深度學習和大型語言模型（LLM）的方法在交通預測方面取得了進展，但它們往往仍然以時間為中心，並缺乏在不斷變化的交通模式下對時間、頻譜、成對空間和高階結構線索的有效協調。為了解決這一異質依賴協調問題，我們提出了STHMoE，一種用於城市交通數據預測的時空超圖增強專家混合框架。STHMoE將交通動態解耦為頻域、時域、空間域和高階空間表示，這些表示由基於部分凍結LLM骨幹構建的提示引導異質專家建模。前三個專家利用特定領域的統計提示，而高階空間專家則使用結構佔位符提示，並從自適應超圖模塊中獲取依賴信息。為了捕捉交通數據中不斷演變的空間結構，STHMoE共同學習一階圖依賴和高階群體互動，而無需預定義的拓撲結構。具有熵感知的MoE路由器通過變異係數負載平衡自適應地融合專家輸出，同時提高專家利用率和路由信心。在10個真實世界交通基準上的實驗顯示，STHMoE在時間、時空圖和基於LLM的基準之間達到了具有競爭力的性能。
